steps.text: Board between the players; conflict pawn on the neutral middle space
The {n} Military tokens faceup on their spaces
Shuffle the Progress tokens; {n} random ones faceup on the board, box the rest
Box {n} random cards from each Age deck, unseen
Shuffle 3 random Guilds into the Age III deck; box the other Guilds
Age III: no Guilds - shuffle in 3 random Grand Temples instead
Reveal 4 random Wonders: first player takes 1, second takes 2, first takes the last
Reveal 4 more and repeat, starting with the second player
steps.note: First game: use the Wonders listed on p.7 instead

steps.text: Age I structure: {n} random Mythology tokens faceup on the marked spaces
Pantheon board above the base board; shuffle the 5 Mythology decks beside it
Offering tokens, Gate card, Snake token and Minerva pawn beside the Pantheon
Buying a resource costs 2 + the opponent's brown/grey production of it
Age II: Gate card into the empty Pantheon space, reveal the Divinities, 3 Offering tokens on the structure
Lay out the Age I card structure; the first player takes a card
